authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9216 bāla includes bālaka boy and regional bālak babe. Hadoti bāḷɛk child fits that k-extension with retroflex lateral and fronted vowel retained; learned versus vernacular regional transmission remains open. Exact survey form bāḷɛk is preserved.

Hadoti bāḷɛk child fits that k-extension with retroflex lateral and fronted vowel retained; learned versus vernacular regional transmission remains open. Exact survey form bāḷɛk is preserved. proposals.evidence: CDIAL 2360.4 *udukkhala gives Sindhi ukhirī, Hindi ūkhlī and Gujarati ukhṛī mortar. Goj ūkhṛī and Hadoti ɔ̃khrī fit this contracted mortar branch, retaining vowel/nasal differences and the rhotic. Exact survey form ɔ̃kʰrī is preserved.
